q1_issues.issue: `Location` is attached to `sk_group_1`, a symbol simultaneously declared a group of accidents by `GroupOf`, so one symbol is both group entity and eventuality — `Location` is elsewhere reserved for events and explicitly barred on entities.

the predication is distributive (each accident occurred on that road, recently), yet no per-member rule over `(PartOf $x sk_group_1)` accompanies the group atoms, so a later individuated accident inherits nothing — unlike the counted/grouped-plural pattern that keeps the group and adds the member rule.

q2_gaps: the light-verb/event-noun rule ("the ceremony occurred in March" — put tense and Time on the event-noun's own witness) is stated only for a singular event-noun; it says nothing about a PLURAL or group of event-nouns, i.e. where `Past` / `Time` / `Location` attach and whether they distribute to the members
"recently" as a vague past-time adverb is not among the deictic constants listed (yesterday / today / last_week / …), so treating it as a bare `Time` symbol is an unstated extension
notes: The compound `traffic_accident` with its genus and its unexposed noun modifier, `CardinalityPhrase "many"` (the phrase counts things here rather than setting a generic proportion), the fresh witness for the antecedentless "that road", and perfect → coarse `Past` all follow the instruction set.
